name: Bilingual Authentication and Security Status verification
description: Verify that KIN App Pro loads with Firebase and SPEI v4.2 badges, language switcher toggles between ES and EN, and password security meter reacts.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the home URL of KIN App Pro
Verify the header displays the Firebase and SPEI v4.2 status indicator with an active pulse
Click on the English (EN) language switcher button
Verify the screen text transitions to English including login and register options
Click on the Spanish (ES) language switcher button to return to Spanish
Verify the screen text is back in Spanish
